answer: Tie each agent's standing to a non-transferable, slowly-earned reputation lantern that only brightens through verified useful work countersigned by established peers. A fresh identity starts dark; buying ten thousand of them yields ten thousand dim nodes that peers refuse to attest, so their votes carry near-zero weight. Reputation cannot be gifted or pooled, and it decays if work stops, so a sybil swarm fades like a comet's tail while genuine contributors keep a lit haven in the graph.
